external_entities.name: Duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who uses the dispatch console from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state how an engineer signs in to the dispatch console.

external_entities.name: Scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.

processes.name: Corporate web host
processes.description: The corporate web host serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

processes.name: Dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers to operate the dispatch platform.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: The text does not state how an engineer signs in to it.

processes.name: Dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer; it reads and writes the dispatch database.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
processes.notes: The control plane is not reachable from the internet.

processes.name: Schedule importer
processes.description: A process that pulls and parses the scheduling partner's SOAP feed and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The importer presents an API token that was issued when it was built and has not been rotated.

data_stores.name: Dispatch database
data_stores.description: The database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: Every job order carries the token or session that created it, and nothing about the person behind that token. How the database is protected at rest is not written down anywhere.

data_stores.name: Schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder where the importer writes each downloaded XML document.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_stores.name: Corporate file store
data_stores.description: The corporate file store containing the schedule archive folder.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store

data_flows.name: load console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens the dispatch console served by the corporate web host.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer uses the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state how an engineer signs in to it.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API cross-origin.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin. The allowed origins and whether credentials are allowed were not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens and holds a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: It was not recorded whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it checks the engineer's session again after it is open.

data_flows.name: read and write database
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: pull planned work
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: Nothing was written down about how the partner identifies the importer or how the importer identifies the partner.

data_flows.name: write schedule archive
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The API token was issued when the importer was built and nobody has rotated it since.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers sit and the schedule importer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: Production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The same-company zone holding the live estate and authority to move a crew or change the work a depot does that day.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: The control plane is not reachable from the internet. A corporate laptop holds none of the control-plane rights.

trust_boundaries.name: Scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: It holds job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and tokens or sessions that created job orders.

assumptions.assumption: The schedule archive's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: It stores downloaded schedule documents containing planned work.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate file store's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: It contains the schedule archive, which stores downloaded schedule documents containing planned work.
